response:
Diagnosis after gen 8, the decisive round. Three findings shape this final batch. First, the EBITDA/EV anchor is the best value channel: inside the split frame it produced FMB 4.97, alpha 0.045 (t = 3.40) and Sharpe 0.519 — best on two of three criteria — because operating profit deflated by enterprise value cannot be inflated by balance-sheet estimates the way book equity can. Second, the largest and most reliable alphas came from measuring accrual contamination *inside* the value measure (SplitHardBookValue: alpha 0.055, t = 4.43) or from the cash-flow-statement accrual definition (SplitCashFlowStatementAccruals: alpha 0.060, t = 3.59), the latter at a coverage cost (0.089) and with a weak slope. Third, two things reliably destroy performance and are now excluded: industry z-scoring each channel (alpha collapsed to 0.005, so a material part of the abnormal return is legitimate cross-industry variation in cash, leverage and accrual intensity) and excessive breadth (the six-channel tax variant fell to alpha 0.026). The final proposals therefore combine the two strongest value anchors, test the cash-flow-statement accrual definition net of depreciation, probe whether an explicit accrual screen still adds once book value is already accrual-corrected, and close with a parsimony test and a no-lag high-coverage version.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: SplitEbitdaEVHardBook
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(che, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), SUMRANK(RATIO(ebitda, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che))), RATIO(SUB(ceq, SUB(SUB(act, che), lct)), MUL(prcc_f, csho))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheapness is trustworthy when it appears both in operating profit per dollar of enterprise value and in book equity stripped of soft non-cash working capital, held by a cash-rich, low-debt firm.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: These are the archive's two best-performing value channels — EBITDA/EV owns the strongest cross-sectional slope and Sharpe, hard book-to-market the strongest alpha t-statistic — and they contaminate differently, since one bypasses the balance sheet entirely while the other cleans it. Combining exactly four equally weighted channels respects the finding that quarter-weights maximize alpha and that further breadth dilutes it.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: SplitEbitdaEVCashFlowAccruals
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(che, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), SUMRANK(RATIO(ebitda, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che))), NEG(RATIO(ADD(SUB(ib, oancf), dpc), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: The sharpest measure of accrual reliance is net income minus operating cash flow with depreciation added back, since it captures every non-depreciation accrual directly from the cash-flow statement without balance-sheet differencing error.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The cash-flow-statement accrual definition delivered the archive's largest alpha (0.060) but was bundled with book value and depreciation, leaving its slope weak (2.01); pairing it instead with the highest-slope value anchor should supply the cross-sectional monotonicity it lacked. Adding depreciation back isolates exactly the discretionary accruals the value-trap story concerns, rather than mixing them with capital-intensity effects.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: SplitHardBookCashFlowAccruals
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(che, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(ceq, SUB(SUB(act, che), lct)), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(SUB(ib, oancf), dpc), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: Cheap firms whose book value consists of hard assets and whose earnings are confirmed by operating cash flow are the purest expression of quality-supported value; the balance sheet and the cash-flow statement must agree.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This pairs the two ingredients with the highest alpha t-statistics in the archive (4.43 and 3.59) and they are conceptually complementary: one removes soft assets from the stock measure of value, the other removes soft earnings from the flow measure of profit. If alpha exceeds 0.055 with t above 4, the interaction is confirmed on both financial statements simultaneously rather than through a single accrual proxy.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: SplitEbitdaEVHardBookSloan
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(che, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ebitda, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che))), RATIO(SUB(ceq, SUB(SUB(act, che), lct)), MUL(prcc_f, csho))), NEG(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(wcap, 1), dp), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: An explicit flow-based accrual screen still adds information beyond an accrual-corrected book value, because stripping soft assets from the balance sheet says nothing about how fast those assets are currently being built.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Signal 1 embeds quality in the value measure only as a stock correction, so this variant asks whether the change in working capital — the flow that predicts reversal — remains incrementally informative once the stock correction is applied. The comparison of the two is the last open question about how the accruals theme should enter the composite.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: SplitAccrualPurgedCashEarningsYield
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(che, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), RATIO(SUB(ADD(ib, dp), DELTA(wcap, 1)), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))
HYPOTHESIS: Value and quality can be fused into a single channel — the price paid per dollar of accrual-purged cash earnings — and given half the total weight alongside the cash and debt channels, without needing separate value and quality ranks.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This yield failed badly on its own (alpha −0.024, t = −2.46) because a price-deflated cash-earnings measure is heavily HML-loaded, so testing it inside the split frame identifies whether the cash and debt channels are sufficient to neutralize that loading. It is the most parsimonious version of the whole research idea, and if it matches the four-channel composites, the mechanism reduces to cash-backed cash earnings.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: SplitNoLagBroadCoverage
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(che, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ebitda, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che))), RATIO(SUB(ceq, SUB(SUB(act, che), lct)), MUL(prcc_f, csho))), SUMRANK(RATIO(dp, at), RATIO(txp, at))))
HYPOTHESIS: The cash-backed clean-value effect can be measured entirely from current-year statements — conservative depreciation and a tax liability substitute for lagged accrual changes — extending the signal to firms with only one year of data.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every strong signal in the archive is capped near 0.110 coverage by the two-year requirement of DELTA(wcap, 1), whereas depreciation intensity and taxes payable are contemporaneous quality proxies that previously reached 0.136 and 0.123 coverage with FMB above 4. This tests whether roughly a quarter more firm-months can be signalled without losing the abnormal return, which matters for whether the result is an implementable strategy or a narrow-sample artifact.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
